# Pretext 0.0.9

Unmodified runtime ES modules from the official `@chenglou/pretext@0.0.9` npm
package, by Cheng Lou: https://github.com/chenglou/pretext

Only the modules needed by `dist/layout.js` are included. License: MIT (see LICENSE).
The versioned directory pins all transitive browser imports without a CDN dependency.
